title: True Form of the Puppet
next_chapter_hook: The moment the token touched his palm, Chen Ji felt an intense resonance from deep within the Tianji Record—as if memories dormant for a thousand years were awakening.

text.content:
At that moment, time seemed to freeze.

Chen Ji's heart clenched. He saw clearly—the puppets' faces were not vaguely similar, but shared his exact contours. His eyes, his nose bridge, his lips forever carrying that trace of cold detachment... all had been replicated on these cold puppets.

"How... how is this possible..." His voice echoed through the empty stone chamber, carrying an unprecedented tremor.

dialogue.content:
He stepped back, his fingertips instinctively touching his chest—where the Tianji Record Fragment lay hidden, faintly scalding. "What exactly are you?"

The puppets gave no answer. They slowly raised their hands and removed the black masks from their faces.

text.content:
The crisp sound of the mask hitting the ground was like thunder.

A face identical to Chen Ji's was exposed in the dim light. More terrifyingly, those puppet's eyes held none of the emptiness that puppets should have—their pupils burned with an indescribable will, as if examining prey that had fallen into a trap.

Chen Ji felt a剧烈的眩晕. He remembered Mo Xiansheng's words: "The Tianji Record has scattered many pieces across the world"—could he have never been the only one?

dialogue.content:
"Finally willing to show your true face, Chen Ji?"

That voice—that voice so familiar it made him sick—emerged from the central puppet. Identical timbre, identical tone, as if looking into a mirror.

"Or should I call you 'Original'?" The puppet tilted its head, revealing a cruel smile, "After all, we are of the same source and born together."

text.content:
Of the same source and born together.

These four words pierced Chen Ji's heart like four blades. He stared intently at that face identical to his own, fragments flashing through his mind like lightning—the origin of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's unfinished words, Chen Tianming's gaze in his final moments...

All mysteries converged at this moment. He was not the sole inheritor of the Tianji Record. From the beginning, he had been designated as a "vessel"—and these puppets were the true backup plan prepared by the Heavenly Eye.

choice.prompt: Facing this "shadow" of the same origin, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Since the other party revealed itself voluntarily, there must be a reason it must speak. Chen Ji decided to retreat strategically, extracting more secrets about the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Eye.
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may use this to shake Chen Ji's faith

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the turbulent waves in his heart. His gaze gradually regained that unique calm and calculation of his.

"Of the same source and born together? Interesting." He spoke slowly, his voice steady as if not facing a truth sufficient to overturn his understanding, "Since you're 'me,' you should know—I don't do meaningless things. What's your real purpose for revealing yourself now?"

choices.description: No matter who you are, using my face means paying a price. Chen Ji decided to strike first. Even if this puppet shares his origin, he wanted to see what this puppet is made of.
choices.risk_hint: The opponent's strength is unknown; reckless attacks may result in吃亏

text.content:
A fierce killing intent flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He hesitated no longer, channeling spiritual energy through his fingertips into a streak of cyan light that shot straight for the puppet's face!

"Bang!"

The puppet didn't budge, blocking with one hand, while Chen Ji was sent staggering backward, his palms tingling.

"This is your choice?" The puppet tilted its head, "As expected of the Original—foolish, but effective."

choices.description: Even if we're twins, what does it matter? Chen Ji never lacked the talent for sharp-tongued humiliation—he would let this imposter know what real psychological warfare is.
choices.visible_reward: Dampen the opponent's momentum, seize initiative

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly laughed, the sound echoing through the stone chamber, carrying an indecipherable mockery.

"Of the same source and born together? I think you're the defective product." He leisurely straightened his sleeves, "You can draw a tiger's skin but not its bones—even if given my face, you'll never grasp what's in this brain of mine. Is this the Heavenly Eye's taste?"

The puppet's smile froze for an instant, then became even more sinister.

"Your mouth is as讨厌 as the records describe." Its voice cooled, "But it doesn't matter—when the Heavenly Eye truly awakens, even your screams will be silenced."

dialogue.content:
The puppet stepped forward slowly, each step landing on Chen Ji's heartstrings.

"Did you think the Tianji Record chose you by chance? You're merely one chess piece the Heavenly Eye fished from the river of destiny—there are countless others like you in this world." It spread its arms wide, "We are all vessels, all backups. It's just that you—the chess piece—are more useful than the others."

"So, becoming discarded pieces?" Chen Ji coldly interjected.

"No." The puppet shook its head, "It's 'upgrading.' When you become strong enough, that's when you get devoured. This isn't punishment—it's... destiny."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill.

He had always thought he was playing against fate, never imagining that even "being chosen" itself was part of fate. The Tianji Record was not a blessing, but a shackle; foresight was not an ability, but an accelerated countdown to death.

Yet his gaze wavered not at all.

Remembering grudges without recklessness—he whispered in his heart. If this is the truth, then shatter it. He never believed in "predetermined destiny," because true strong ones are always those who write fate.

dialogue.content:
"Interesting." The puppet suddenly stopped, tilting its head to examine Chen Ji, "Your eyes... are different from the other vessels. After learning the truth, they either collapsed or went mad. Only you—"

"Only me what?"

"Only you are still calculating." The puppet's tone carried for the first time some indescribable emotion, "This is also one of the reasons I was created. To act with you, to grow with you, until the very end—to devour you, replace you, and become the 'real Chen Ji.'"

choice.prompt: The puppet revealed the Heavenly Eye's true plan, and Chen Ji must respond:

choices.description: "Replace me? You're just a copy with no will of your own. What right do you have to speak of 'becoming me'?" Chen Ji decided to psychologically crush this puppet's superiority from the start.
choices.risk_hint: The puppet may act rashly in desperation

dialogue.content:
"Replace me?" Chen Ji let out a light laugh, one filled with undisguised contempt, "You don't even know who you are, do you? Do you have independent thought? Do you have people you care about? Have you experienced the despair and joy of struggling upward step by step from desperate circumstances?"

He stepped forward, staring directly into the puppet's eyes: "You're nothing but an empty shell. Even with my face, you're not 'Chen Ji.' The real Chen Ji was forged through every battle, every calculation, every obsession over these years—and you have none of that."

choices.description: "You're a puppet, but you have your own consciousness, don't you? Will the Heavenly Eye spare you after using you?" Chen Ji decided to try turning this "other self."
choices.risk_hint: The puppet may feign wavering to extract intelligence

dialogue.content:
"You call yourself a 'backup piece'—so let me ask you, after the Heavenly Eye's chess game ends, what fate awaits this 'backup'?" Chen Ji's tone suddenly became calm and sincere, "Devour me, replace me, and then what? Do you think it will let you survive? It only wants the vessel called 'Chen Ji,' not you, not me."

He extended his hand: "I'm seriously asking you—can you truly be content as an eternal substitute?"

text.content:
The puppet fell silent for a moment.

On that face identical to Chen Ji's, a complex expression actually flickered—，仿佛某种被深埋的情感正在挣扎着苏醒。

"You're very clever." It finally spoke, its voice several degrees lower than before, "But some things can't be changed by cleverness alone."

dialogue.content:
The puppet suddenly raised its hand, taking out a token from its chest.

The token was ancient and weighty, completely black, with a符文 on its front that Chen Ji recognized instantly—it was Chen Tianming's mark!

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

"Chen Tianming's legacy." The puppet held the token in its palm, "Things he left before his death. Should have been delivered to you, but somehow ended up here." It paused, "I'm here to return it—believe it or not, this is the only thing I can do."

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Tianming's legacy and this mysterious puppet, Chen Ji must make a final decision:

choices.description: Whatever the puppet's purpose, Chen Tianming's legacy absolutely cannot fall into the Heavenly Eye's hands. Chen Ji decided to secure the token first, then plan accordingly.
choices.risk_hint: The token may contain a trap

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't hesitate. He stepped forward and took the token from the puppet's palm.

The moment it touched his hand, a familiar aura rushed toward him—that was Chen Tianming's unique spiritual fluctuation, as if穿越了时光，正温柔地注视着他。

"...Why?" he asked softly.

The puppet gave no answer, merely stepping back and replacing its mask. "See you in the next scroll, 'Original.'"

choices.description: "There's no free lunch in this world. You want to use Chen Tianming's legacy to sway me?" Chen Ji decided to refuse, to guard against this being a trap set by the Heavenly Eye.

dialogue.content:
"Put it away." Chen Ji stepped back, "I don't need charity—whether from you or from the Heavenly Eye."

The puppet's movement froze. After a moment, it let out an ambiguous laugh. "Interesting. As cautious as the records describe." It tucked the token back into its chest, "Since you don't want it, so be it. After all—what's meant to come will come."

With that, a faint black mist suddenly spread from its body, and its form began to blur.

text.content:
As the black mist spread, all the puppet's forms turned to nothing, as if they had never existed.

Only the central puppet lingered for a moment. Through the gradually dissipating black mist, it gazed at Chen Ji, and in those eyes identical to Chen Ji's, a fleeting... admiration?

"Take care, 'Original.'" Its voice became ethereal, "The next time we meet will be when the Heavenly Eye awakens. Then—only one of us can remain."

The black mist cleared, and the stone chamber fell into deathly silence once more.

Chen Ji stood alone, the token clutched tightly in his hand. His heart was still racing, but his thoughts were crystal clear.

Of the same source and born together. Backup pieces. Devouring and replacement.

This was the true nature of destiny he had been fighting all along—a game board set from his birth, and he was merely the piece about to be sacrificed.

But a cold smile slowly curved Chen Ji's lips.

Remembering grudges without recklessness. He recorded everything. Today's events, he noted them all. The Heavenly Eye wanted to make him a chess piece? Then the ending of this game will be something even the Heavenly Eye itself couldn't foresee.

He lowered his head and examined the token in his palm once more.

On the jet-black surface, Chen Tianming's mark glowed faintly in the dim light. He could sense the spiritual energy contained within—was it a sealed memory, or some kind of guidance?

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment at his chest suddenly vibrated intensely.

An unprecedented resonance burst forth from the token, shooting straight into the depths of the Tianji Record—as if something dormant for millennia was slowly awakening.

Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat.

He clearly felt the originally blurred seal within the Tianji Record loosening—that was the precursor to "unlocking the next page of knowledge" that Mo Xiansheng had mentioned.

Could Chen Tianming's legacy actually be the key to unsealing the Tianji Record?

He took a deep breath and pressed the token against his chest. In an instant, a gentle light emerged from the token, projecting a blurry image into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—a blood-red sky, and a figure kneeling in the ruins.

That figure turned its head, revealing a face that made Chen Ji's pupils shrink.

—
